title: Marshmallow fondant will sweeten any celebration
description: I woke up this morning to the aftermath of my son’s birthday party. There are green balloons, Minecraft banners, gift bags, and tissue paper all over my house. I spent all weekend cooking and planning for his pool party with all his friends, and when it was over, he said it was the best party ever. My sweet (almost) 7-year-old woke up today to beautiful winter and a beautiful life, and before he left his bed, he looked under his pillow for the tooth fairy’s gift; yesterday was exciting, indeed. He played with new toys while his mama cooked breakfast, and then he got pulled to school on his sled through the fluffy fresh snow. I spoil him, it’s true.
